note: These are editorial delivery choices. Recheck current platform/account acceptance at upload. A shared vertical master is allowed only after each platform preview passes.

linkedin.companion: Image comment only if the selected connector supports it. Otherwise document/image post and a text link.

youtube_shorts.companion: On-screen takeaway and related long video/profile destination. Shorts comment/description URLs are not the primary download route.

instagram_reel.companion: Separate carousel of useful instructions, with a profile/download destination.

tiktok.companion: Useful ending card or separate photo companion. Obtain actual account privacy, comments, music, and disclosure choices before platform posting.

weekly.rule: Use only accepted assets and verified results. Add new synthesis, a useful downloadable index, and what changed. Shorten or report a blocked edition rather than pad an empty week.

audio.narration: Original authorized recording or already approved licensed non-impersonating voice. No cloning.
audio.targets: Use a documented loudness target, avoid clipping, mix for intelligibility, and review on actual playback. A numerical loudness pass does not prove a good mix.

qa.captions: Spell-check names and technical terms, verify timing, use phone-scale review and actual platform overlay previews.
qa.readiness: All required files, real motion/audio review, claim checks, rights, durable readback, and current hashes must pass. Platform drafts and final publication are separate states.
